description.zh: 产品类型，目前仅支持**ANT_CLOUD_AUTH**（金融级实人），其他均退市。
description.en: The product type. Currently, only **ANT_CLOUD_AUTH** (financial-grade ID Verification) is supported. All other types have been discontinued.

description.zh: 流控统计窗口大小，单位分钟。
description.en: The size of the rate limiting statistical window, in minutes.
The API name, which is the same as **ProductCode**.

description.zh:
流程类型：
- **ACCUMULATE**： 身份证重复出现
- **PASSED_RATE**： 通过率小于
- **SUB_CODE_205**：认证不通过且活体攻击205比例大于
- **SUB_CODE_206**：认证不通过且活体攻击206比例大于
description.en:
The flow type. Valid values:
- **ACCUMULATE**: repeated occurrence of an ID card.
- **PASSED_RATE**: pass rate is less than.
- **SUB_CODE_205**: authentication failed and the proportion of liveness attack 205 is greater than.
- **SUB_CODE_206**: authentication failed and the proportion of liveness attack 206 is greater than.

The status. Valid values:
- **disabled**: disabled.
- **normal**: enabled.

title.zh: 调整自定义流控策略列表
title.en: Adjust custom rate limiting policy list

descriptions.zh:
- 请求方法：支持以HTTPS POST和GET方法发送请求。
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com。
descriptions.en:
- Request method: HTTPS POST and GET methods are supported.
- Endpoint: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth modify-customize-flow-strategy-list --strategy-object Status=disabled AccumulateKey=- ApiName=ID_PRO UserId=126005125163 AccumulateWindow=60 FlowType=ACCUMULATE Id=38 Operation=- Threshold=10 --product-type ANT_CLOUD_AUTH --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
